name: m-dh-hover
js: (() => { const d = document.querySelector('.dh-dot.typ'); d.classList.add('hv'); const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = '.dh-dot.hv .dh-tip{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)} .dh-dot.hv::after{transform:scale(1.35)}'; document.head.append(s); return [...document.querySelectorAll('.dh-stats dd')].map(x => x.textContent); })()

name: m-cat-mid
js: (async () => { document.querySelector('.cr[data-type=biryani]').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 260)); return document.documentElement.dataset.vt || 'none'; })()

name: m-cat-end
js: (async () => { document.querySelector('.cr[data-type=kacchi]').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2500)); return [...document.querySelectorAll('.dh-stats dd')].map(x => x.textContent).concat(document.querySelector('.cr.on .cr-ind') ? 'ring ok' : 'no ring'); })()

name: m-morph-mid
js: (async () => { const c = document.querySelector('.rc[data-vt]'); c.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); c.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 330)); return document.documentElement.dataset.vt || 'none'; })()

name: m-back-mid
js: (async () => { const c = document.querySelector('.rc[data-vt]'); c.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2500)); history.back(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); return document.documentElement.dataset.vt || 'none'; })()
